nodes.description: Private _owner address in Ownable, holds the privileged account allowed to mint and administrate.
Mapping of account balances mutated in _transfer and _mint.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances, mutated by _approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply increased only by _mint.
Pausable flag read by whenNotPaused/whenPaused and flipped by pause and unpause.
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller used for ownership checks and as token sender/spender.
Context helper returning msg.sender, the source of all caller identity in this contract.
Public transfer moving tokens from _msgSender() to recipient, guarded by whenNotPaused.
Public transferFrom that performs _transfer before validating and decrementing the allowance.
Public approve setting _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] to amount.
Public increaseAllowance adding addedValue to the current allowance with an unchecked addition.
Public decreaseAllowance subtracting subtractedValue from the current allowance.
Owner only mint entry point that creates new supply for recepient.
Owner only ownership transfer to newOwner written into _owner.
Owner only function clearing _owner to the zero address.
Owner only function setting _paused to true.
Owner only function setting _paused to false.
Empty payable function that accepts arbitrary ETH with no accounting or withdrawal path.
Internal transfer updating _balances for sender and recipient.
Internal mint increasing _totalSupply and the target balance.
Internal approve writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
onlyOwner modifier comparing owner() to _msgSender() before guarded functions execute.
Unchecked raw addition of addedValue onto the stored allowance in increaseAllowance.
payable ETH receiving entry point with no withdrawal logic, permanently locking funds.
transferFrom moves balances before the allowance is verified and decremented, an unsafe state ordering.
recipient argument of transfer.
amount argument of transfer.
sender argument of transferFrom, the account whose allowance is spent.
recipient argument of transferFrom.
amount argument of transferFrom compared against the allowance.
spender argument of approve.
amount argument of approve written into the allowance mapping.
addedValue argument of increaseAllowance added without SafeMath.
subtractedValue argument of decreaseAllowance.
recepient argument of mint receiving newly created tokens.
amount argument of mint controlling new supply.
newOwner argument of transferOwnership.
Local currentAllowance in transferFrom holding the spender allowance during checks.
Local senderBalance in _transfer holding the sender balance before subtraction.
Local currentAllowance in decreaseAllowance holding the allowance before subtraction.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender().
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending account.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance check.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() to index _allowances.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() to index _allowances.
mint is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() against msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() against msg.sender.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() against msg.sender.
pause is gated by onlyOwner, comparing owner() with msg.sender.
unpause is gated by onlyOwner, comparing owner() with msg.sender.
onlyOwner reads _owner through owner() to authorize the call.
onlyOwner modifier guards mint against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards pause.
onlyOwner modifier guards unpause.
transfer delegates balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before verifying and decrementing the allowance.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the summed allowance.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance.
mint delegates supply creation to _mint.
_transfer subtracts from sender and adds to recipient inside _balances.
_mint adds amount to the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_approve writes the amount into _allowances.
transferFrom reads and rewrites the caller allowance in _allowances.
increaseAllowance mutates _allowances using an unchecked raw addition.
decreaseAllowance reduces the value stored in _allowances.
whenNotPaused reads _paused before transfer executes.
pause sets _paused to true, an owner-only state change.
unpause sets _paused to false, an owner-only state change.
The unchecked sum in increaseAllowance is the arithmetic unsafe operation.
pay() is a payable entry point that receives ETH with no state accounting or withdrawal path.
transferFrom mutates balances before the allowance check and decrement, an unsafe ordering.
transferFrom loads the spender allowance into local currentAllowance.
The reduced currentAllowance is written back through _approve within transferFrom.
_transfer loads _balances[sender] into local senderBalance.
senderBalance is decremented with SafeMath and stored back into _balances.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced local allowance back into _allowances via _approve.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into the balance arithmetic of transfer.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom and indexes _allowances.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter is compared with and subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
spender parameter flows into approve.
amount parameter is stored by approve.
addedValue parameter is added to the allowance in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowance in decreaseAllowance.
recepient parameter receives minted tokens in mint.
amount parameter controls minted supply in mint.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged _owner in transferOwnership.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient only exists as the destination argument of transfer.
amount only exists as the value argument of transfer.
sender is the allowance owner argument used only inside transferFrom.
recipient is the destination argument used only inside transferFrom.
amount is the spender value argument used only inside transferFrom.
spender is the allowance target argument of approve.
amount is the allowance value argument of approve.
addedValue is only meaningful as the increment argument of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is only meaningful as the decrement argument of decreaseAllowance.
recepient is the mint beneficiary argument used only inside mint.
amount is the minted quantity argument used only inside mint.
newOwner is only meaningful as the ownership target argument of transferOwnership.
currentAllowance is a temporary inside transferFrom and should be abstracted into it.
senderBalance is a temporary inside _transfer and should be abstracted into the balance update.
currentAllowance is a temporary inside decreaseAllowance and should be abstracted into it.
